title: 3 Mistakes First-Time Visitors Make in China | China Travel Expert
description:
Three rookie mistakes I watch first-timers make in China every season — and the fixes.

Mistake 1: Everyone crowds onto the Badaling Great Wall, which draws roughly 70% of all Wall visitors. Hike Mutianyu (restored, cable car + toboggan) or Jinshanling (wild, photographer-grade ridgelines) instead. Mistake 2: Cramming six cities into five days — Beijing to Shanghai alone is about 4.5 hours on the high-speed train, so slow down. Mistake 3: Showing up at the Forbidden City with no booking — it's closed most Mondays and sells no walk-up tickets. (Opinions are my own; facts are verified.)

🧭 Expert Tip: Book the Palace Museum online the moment the window opens — 20:00 Beijing time, exactly 7 days before your visit — using your passport for the real-name booking. There are no same-day tickets.

第一次来中国，别只去八达岭、别五天赶六城、故宫记得提前预约。

—
I'm mapping ALL of China — real food, real streets, real prices, zero tourist traps.
